A single isolated dish only, no food faces, no characters, no spoons/chopsticks, no text, no labels, no logos, no decorations, no steam/fire/effects, no tabletop/background, no white sticker border, no photorealism, no 3D, no smooth gradients. Make the dish smaller rather than cutting any part off. No object may touch the canvas edges.
